words.example: The lab changed the voltage accordingly.
words.exampleZh: 實驗室因此調整了電壓。
words.notes: 也可指相應地。act accordingly 是採取相應行動。

words.example: The accuracy of this clock is poor.
words.exampleZh: 這個時鐘的精確度不好。
words.notes: accurate 是精確的。accurately 是精確地。

words.example: There is no alternative to this chip.
words.exampleZh: 這顆晶片沒有替代選項。
words.notes: have no alternative but to do 是只好做某事。

words.example: This circuit is analogous to a switch.
words.notes: be analogous to 是與某物相似。analog device 是模擬裝置。

words.example: She studies astronomy after work.
words.notes: astronomer 是天文學家。astronomical 是天文學的。

words.example: She is an authority on circuits.
words.notes: have the authority to do 是有權做某事。也可指權力。

words.example: The battery is almost flat.
words.notes: recharge the battery 是為電池充電。正負極會標在電池上。

words.example: In this circumstance the test stops.
words.exampleZh: 在這種情況下測試會停止。
words.notes: in the circumstances 是在這種情況下。in no circumstances 是絕不。

words.example: The test measures visual cognition.
words.exampleZh: 這項測驗測量視覺認知。
words.notes: social cognition 是社會認知。artificial cognition 是人工識別。

words.example: The two chips are not comparable.
words.exampleZh: 這兩顆晶片無法相提並論。
words.notes: be comparable to 或 with 是可比得上。也可指類似的。

words.example: Competition in this field is sharp.
words.exampleZh: 這個領域的競爭很激烈。
words.notes: be in competition with 是與某人競爭。fierce competition 是激烈競爭。

words.example: They tested the composition of the alloy.
words.notes: compose 是構成。compositional 是組成的。也可指創作。

words.example: Compression reduces the file size.
words.notes: compress 是壓縮。也可指濃縮或濃度。

words.example: Cool air will condense on the glass.
words.exampleZh: 冷空氣會在玻璃上冷凝。
words.notes: condense sth into sth 是把某物壓縮成另一物。也可指壓縮。

words.example: Copper has high conductivity.
words.notes: conductive 是有傳導性的。

words.example: Copper is a good conductor.
words.notes: good conductor 是良導體。poor conductor 是不良導體。也可指導體之外的領導者。

words.example: The team must confront the fault.
words.exampleZh: 團隊必須面對這個故障。
words.notes: be confronted with 是面臨。confront sb with sth 是使某人面對某事。

words.example: She is a contemporary researcher.
words.notes: be contemporary with 是與某人同屬一個時代。作名詞是同代人。

words.example: The new part will contribute to speed.
words.exampleZh: 新零件有助於提升速度。
words.notes: contribute to 是有助於。to 後接事物或動名詞。

words.example: They dedicate the lab to pure research.
words.exampleZh: 他們把實驗室奉獻給純研究。
words.notes: dedicate oneself to 是致力於。be dedicated to 是獻身於。

words.example: The deviation is within one percent.
words.notes: deviate 是脫離或越軌。

words.example: He is devoted to circuit design.
words.notes: devoted to 後接名詞。也可指忠實的，如盡職的父親。

words.example: They may discontinue the old line.
words.exampleZh: 他們可能中止舊產品線。
words.notes: 由 dis 與 continue 構成。報紙停刊也可用這個詞。

words.example: The discovery changed the design.
words.notes: make a discovery 是有所發現。scientific discovery 是科學發現。

words.example: The electrode must stay dry.
words.notes: negative electrode 是負極。positive electrode 是正極。

words.example: Electrolysis splits the water.
words.notes: by electrolysis 是透過電解。water electrolysis 是水電解。

words.example: Each electron carries a charge.
words.notes: electronic 是電子的。proton 是質子。

words.example: She teaches electronics on Friday.
words.notes: electronics engineer 是電子工程師。electronics industry 是電子業。

words.example: A filter can enhance the signal.
words.notes: enhancement 是增強。raise 是近義。

words.example: The diagram gave some enlightenment.
words.notes: give sb enlightenment 是給某人啟發。age of enlightenment 是啟蒙時期。

words.example: The experimenter logged every trial.
words.exampleZh: 實驗者記錄了每次試驗。
words.notes: experiment 是實驗。experimental 是實驗的。

words.example: Her expertise is in sensors.
words.exampleZh: 她的專門知識是感測器。
words.notes: 作專門知識時不可數。technical expertise 是技術專門知識。

words.example: A checklist will facilitate the setup.
words.exampleZh: 檢核表有助於完成架設。
words.notes: 及物，後接名詞。promote 是近義。

words.example: Few people could foresee this result.
words.exampleZh: 很少人能預見這個結果。
words.notes: 過去式 foresaw，過去分詞 foreseen，都不規則。predict 是近義。

words.example: The panel will generate power at noon.
words.notes: generate electricity 是發電。generate profit 是創造利潤。

words.example: The design shows real genius.
words.exampleZh: 這個設計看得出真正的天分。
words.notes: 指天生的才能時與 talent 近義。talent 較偏可培養的潛力。

words.example: The paper is groundbreaking.
words.notes: groundbreaking research 是具開拓性的研究。path-breaking 是近義。

words.example: The hypothesis still needs a test.
words.notes: hypothesize 是假定。hypothetical 是假設的。

words.example: One inaccuracy can spoil the result.
words.exampleZh: 一處不精確就會毀了結果。
words.notes: 指錯誤時可數，指不準確時不可數。

words.example: The speed is incredible for this size.
words.exampleZh: 以這個尺寸來說，速度難以置信。
words.notes: it is incredible that 後接子句。

words.example: His influence on the lab is large.
words.exampleZh: 他對實驗室的影響力很大。
words.notes: influence on 是對某事的影響。under the influence of 是受到某物影響。

words.example: Rubber acts as an insulator.
words.notes: nonconductor 與 isolator 近義。

words.example: The invention is still a prototype.
words.notes: patent of invention 是發明專利。也可指虛構。

words.example: The inventor filed the papers.
words.notes: creator 是創造者。artificer 也可指巧匠。

words.example: Each matrix holds nine cells.
words.notes: 複數是 matrices 或 matrixes。作模型時與 model 近義。

words.example: The case has a metallic finish.
words.notes: metallic luster 是金屬光澤。metallic conductor 是金屬導體。

words.example: She works in microelectronics.
words.notes: microelectronic 是微電子的。microcomputer 是微型電腦。

words.example: Put the chip under the microscope.
words.notes: under a microscope 是透過顯微鏡。put sth under the microscope 也可指仔細檢查。

words.example: The plastic cooled in the mould.
words.notes: 英式拼成 mould。美式通常寫成 mold。

words.example: Connect the negative terminal first.
words.notes: 也可指否定的。與 positive 相對。

words.example: She is a notable name in optics.
words.notes: be notable for 是以某事聞名。也可指值得注意的、顯著的。

words.example: The approach is novel and simple.
words.exampleZh: 這個方法又新奇又簡單。
words.notes: novelty 是新奇的事物。

words.example: They kept the orthodox method.
words.notes: 也可指公認的。unorthodox 是非正統的。

words.example: She hopes to outdo her last result.
words.exampleZh: 她希望勝過上次的結果。
words.notes: 過去式 outdid，過去分詞 outdone。outdo sb in sth 是在某方面超過某人。

words.example: A charged particle left a trace.
words.notes: charged particle 是帶電粒子。

words.example: The casting pattern is ready.
words.notes: 也可作動詞。be patterned on sth 是模仿某物。

words.example: Do not touch the live pole.
words.notes: positive pole 是正極。anode 是陽極，cathode 是陰極。

words.example: Press the red key to start.
words.notes: press down 是往下按。作名詞可指新聞界。press conference 是記者會。

words.example: Keep the positive lead on the left.
words.notes: 也可指積極的、肯定的。be positive about 是對某事有把握。

words.example: They postulate a hidden leak.
words.exampleZh: 他們假定有一處隱藏的漏電。
words.notes: 也可作名詞，與 assumption 近義。

words.example: We need a precise reading.
words.notes: to be precise 是確切地講。

words.example: Models predict a short delay.
words.exampleZh: 模型預測會有短暫延遲。
words.notes: 後可接 that、whether 或 what。be predicted to do 是被認為將做某事。

words.example: The meter is reliable.
words.notes: reliable information 是可靠的資訊。有比較級與最高級。

words.example: This reproduction is for the demo.
words.exampleZh: 這個複製品是用來展示的。
words.notes: reproduce 是複製。reproductive 是再生的。

words.example: Science class meets at noon.
words.notes: science and technology 是科技。scientific 是科學的。

words.example: The scientist checked the log.
words.notes: scientifically 是科學地。

words.example: The wafer is a semiconductor.
words.notes: 由 semi 與 conductor 構成。semiconductor material 是半導體材料。

words.example: The simulator runs overnight.
words.notes: simulate 是模擬。simulated 是模仿的。

words.example: Call a specialist for the sensor.
words.exampleZh: 感測器的問題要找專家。
words.notes: 指有專門特長的人。expert 可以跨多個領域。

words.example: She has a talent for layout.
words.notes: have a talent for 是有某方面的天分。

words.example: The technological shift was sudden.
words.notes: technique 是手法。technician 是技術員。

words.example: The technology is still immature.
words.notes: advanced technology 是先進技術。information technology 是資訊技術。

words.example: The transistor is on the board.
words.notes: transistor circuit 是電晶體電路。

words.example: Please update the firmware tonight.
words.notes: update sb on sth 是向某人提供最新消息。

words.example: This tool is versatile.
words.notes: 也可指多才多藝的。universal 是通用的。

words.example: This version fixes the leak.
words.notes: 也可指型號。the standard version 是標準版。
